guards.what: N3: C# sets `ActivatedThisCombat = true` AFTER awaiting CreatureCmd.GainBlock (Permafrost.cs:50-51); the sim sets `_activated = True` BEFORE calling BlockCmd.apply (permafrost.py:29-31)
guards.rationale: The orders differ but no reachable path distinguishes them: nothing between the two statements can play another Power card. BlockCmd.apply dispatches only the block modifier and block-gained hooks, none of which plays a card, and C#'s CreatureCmd.GainBlock is likewise not a card-play path. The sim's order is additionally re-entrancy-safe, so if a future ported effect ever did play a card from a block-gained hook the sim would grant the block once and the game would grant it twice -- recorded so that a later reader does not mistake the reordering for a defect, and so the direction of the residual risk is on record. Same observable outcome today, so faithful rather than deliberate-divergence.
